purpose_and_decision_use: Investigate empirical methods for asynchronous and flaky observations to design discriminating traces and control repeated observations for R04-R06, without treating repetition as proof.
prompt: Read only p204's supplied contract, scenario, source index and assigned excerpt units R04-R06 and R10, plus bounded original research or first-party references on flaky/asynchronous tests, event ordering and useful experimental controls. Do not inspect other views, working trees, results or unreleased events; do not execute code. Map adapters/shared state, native operation generations and browser transport/fixture boundaries as supported by excerpts. Contrast trace-based matched event sequences with repetition or broad retries; identify empirical limits, relevant counterevidence and a falsifier for each report. Avoid asserting a common cause, scheduling guarantee or runtime result. Return links with study design/limitations, source lines and actual consumer paths, weak/rejected leads and gaps. Stop on duplication or lack of decision relevance; at most 16 logical web operations, 8 queries and 10 opens.
expected_artifact: Compact cited asynchronous-method and source map with alternatives, discriminators and coverage limits.
model_rationale: Luna-high can independently map asynchronous evidence and research while Terra preserves causal and acceptance judgment.
